hse_environment_gap.reason: Old last-wins observer retained only filtered fields. It did not record full environment size, so the old observation cannot establish empty exit-window data versus nonempty missing variables. Earlier values cannot be reconstructed.
hse_environment_gap.later_observer_fix: For future runs, empty full proc-environ is unavailable and preserves prior positive evidence. Nonempty missing or conflicting values cause sticky rejection. It never repairs historical observations.

raw_obtain: Private task-13 resource-auto evidence and server run resource-auto-20261015-r3 are retained. Ask the project owner for the archive and per-member manifest identified by SHA-256; full commands, inputs, outputs, helper source and observer histories remain there. Machine paths and runtime secrets are not published.

timing_scope.application_e2e: source content check/decode through native index/search and output validation; eager owner/identity setup and evidence serialization separate; per-call or lazy model loads remain included where performed

timing_scope.complete_query_elapsed_s: queries[].elapsed_s includes native return plus complete output validation and query bookkeeping; repeat construction remains inside this query when the native backend performs it
